tree.title: Add a tree
tree.description:
Name the tree ("Golden by the fence", "Cherry on the terrace") and pick its species: the displayed name combines both, so trees stay distinguishable in every list.

The stage advances automatically from accumulated growing degree days, and you are notified each time. You can always correct it by hand — your correction takes precedence. The offset recalibrates the model if your orchard is consistently ahead (positive) or behind (negative) the table.

insufficient_history.title: Not enough recorded history for the disease models
insufficient_history.description:
Over the last {window} hours, only {hours} usable hours of temperature **and** humidity were found in the recorder, where at least {required} are needed.

The disease models (Hutton, Smith, Gubler-Thomas) are defined in continuous hourly runs. With too little history they find no evaluable day and report "no risk" — which is indistinguishable from a genuine absence of risk, and therefore worse than no sensor at all.

Usual causes: the integration was installed less than four days ago (in which case this clears by itself), the sensors are excluded from the recorder, or the recorder purge interval is too short. Frost is unaffected: it relies on forecasts, not history.

no_recorder.title: Recorder unavailable
no_recorder.description:
Météo Sentinelle could not read the history. The disease models cannot run at all: they rebuild hourly series from recorded states.

Check that the `recorder` integration is enabled and that it is not excluding the sensors selected for this site. Frost keeps working, since it only needs forecasts.
